comparison.objective: Extract one connector terminal, versus remove a drawer from its slides.
comparison.physical_skill: One recessed tab released by a blade while wire and tool are pulled together, versus simultaneous opposite-sense lever presses with drawer support and pulling.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits intact; versus both slide releases actuated and drawer removed, set down, released, and still.
comparison.reason: Both involve release-before-pull, but the record tests simultaneous bilateral lever actuation and large-object support rather than blade/tab/wire coordination.
